g.text: SCR07 — ARC session and control
Kotlin Compose screen definition · FR-ARC-01 / 02 / 03 / 04 · blueprint2.0 design only
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · 10
Phone390dp: Viewport followed by tree/input tabs; zoom frame without changing logical coordinates; controls disabled until Connected. Modal drawer
below840dp; persistent rail at840dp+. Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty drafts. Landscape: Same IDs and authorization; wide layout
only when available width>=840dp; never shrink protected actions below48dp.
SCR07.C01 · Connect selected target
Fields: Exact target profile/user, loopback endpoint and protected bearer reference
Open selected outbound ARC socket and validate ID/version/status/capabilities before enabling control
Failure: Wrong token/protocol/EOF shows disconnected state; never sends uncertain input again
SCR07.C02 · Disconnect / cancel
Fields: Selected session/connection epoch; Cancel8 never sent
Close owned watch socket and release local controller resources
Failure: No final frame is assumed; old frame is visibly stale and input disabled
SCR07.C03 · Open navigation
Fields: SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; protected review only via exact command
Open all local destinations through phone drawer or wide rail; Back returns previous screen
Failure: Dirty draft requires Discard/Stay; navigation never commits configuration
SCR07.C04 · Send typed input; disabled unless connected capability/policy permits
Fields: Avalonia key name/text, exact target and current connection/root observation
Send one validated typed key/text command after current shared policy/gate check
Failure: Unknown key/protected/root/policy failure shows CommandResult; no implicit grant or retry
SCR07.C05 · Select target profile
Fields: Target/package/user, endpoint and nonsecret credential alias
Choose saved outbound profile without connecting
Failure: Missing secret/profile requires explicit owner profile edit; no default remote target
SCR07.C06 · Inspect tree or refresh frame
Fields: Frame sequence, pixel/logical size, scale, timestamp and node generation evidence
Open bounded tree/frame observation after exact session authorization
Failure: Disconnected/oversize/protected data denies; stale frame never becomes proof of intended coordinate
SCR07.C07 · Pointer or wheel input
Fields: One pointer,dp coordinates/buttons/wheel axes; no multitouch or remote root-generation claim
Dispatch ordered mouse/wheel batch for current target under service input lease
Failure: Lease conflict/protected root rejects; pressed state released on revoke/owner transition
SCR07.C08 · Inspect target details
Fields: arc-protobuf-v1, envelope1.0, package0.8.0, logical scale and local epoch
Show profile, wire and current connection facts without bearer
Failure: Unknown remote root generation remains unknown
SCR07.C09 · Edit outbound target profile
Fields: Loopback endpoint, target/user, wire profile and encrypted secret reference
Create/edit outbound target profile and owner-provision bearer via SCR09
Failure: Secret fields are protected/not ARC roots; never put bearer in logs/exports/discovery
State definitions — exact enabled/disabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR07.S0 · Disconnected: selected profile only
Disabled: SCR07.C02, SCR07.C04, SCR07.C06, SCR07.C07
Effect: No target frame/tree/input; previous image, if retained, is labeled stale.
Recovery: Edit/select profile then Connect; no input or Disconnect action with no connection.
SCR07.S1 · Wrong target token: disconnected
Disabled: SCR07.C02, SCR07.C04, SCR07.C06, SCR07.C07
Effect: UNAUTHENTICATED response; no target content exposed.
Recovery: Owner edits protected credential reference before a new explicit connection.
SCR07.S2 · Unsupported wire/protocol: disconnected
Disabled: SCR07.C02, SCR07.C04, SCR07.C06, SCR07.C07
Effect: Version/ID/profile validation failed; no target method dispatch.
Recovery: Inspect exact supported profile; never guess or downgrade protocol.
SCR07.S3 · Protected root: frame/input suppressed
Disabled: SCR07.C01, SCR07.C04, SCR07.C06, SCR07.C07
Effect: Connected transport remains known but sensitive target observation/control is denied.
Recovery: Wait for approved ordinary root or disconnect; never bypass protected capture gate.
SCR07.S4 · Connected: bounded target observation
Disabled: SCR07.C01, SCR07.C05, SCR07.C09
Effect: Validated capabilities/target and policy gate control each command; no stale-frame proof.
Recovery: Refresh tree/frame or send one allowed input; close socket to cancel watch.
SCR07.S5 · Connecting: input disabled
Disabled: SCR07.C01, SCR07.C04, SCR07.C05, SCR07.C06, SCR07.C07, SCR07.C09
Effect: One authenticated connection attempt in progress; no ready viewport.
Recovery: Cancel closes socket; timeout/error returns disconnected without input replay.
SCR07.S6 · Input lease conflict: command rejected
Disabled: SCR07.C01, SCR07.C04, SCR07.C07
Effect: No new pointer/key mutation accepted for conflicting principal.
Recovery: Inspect lease owner/reason, wait for release or disconnect; do not steal lease.
